name: dvma-appium-automation
description: Appium + WebdriverIO dynamic-analysis automation suites for DVMA (Damn Vulnerable Mobile App). Exercises every instrumented module to surface its vulnerability. Authorized security-training use only.
comment_appium_drivers: Appium itself and its drivers are installed separately (globally or via appium's own plugin manager), NOT as npm project deps. See automation/README.md. Required: appium (>=2), appium-uiautomator2-driver, appium-xcuitest-driver, appium-flutter-driver.
